Hannah (Sales): Hi team — Lyra.ai wants a hosted POC next Tue. They need a short demo burst + a lower sustained quota. Can infra provision an ephemeral key?
Ravi (Infra): What peak/sustained and windows?
Hannah (Sales): Peak 480 rps for 20m (demo), then 70 rps sustained for 2h. Streaming SSE from servers.
Liam (Platform): We can do a scoped ephemeral key + burst window. Need IP allowlist or API proxy. Streaming increases concurrent connections—we can bump per-key limits.
Priya (Security): Requirements: server-side calls from static egress IPs, key TTL <= 72h (48h preferred), scope locked to generation:read/invoke only, logs redacted, SOC contact on file. No raw payload export.
Hannah (Sales): They can egress from 198.51.100.0/24. TTL 48h ok. SOC: secops@lyra.ai.
Ravi (Infra): I'll open ticket REDWOOD-POC-537. Plan: burst_rate=480 rps for 20m, sustained_rate=70 rps until end, conn_limit=160 for this key. Post the key here when ready.
Ana (SRE): I'll add a dashboard and alert to #eng-oncall if error_rate > 2% or p95 > 1.5s. Also watch connection churn for SSE.
(30m later)
deploy-bot: Ephemeral key created: id ephem_f9b4a, scope=generation:invoke, expires in 48h, IP allowlist applied (198.51.100.0/24). See REDWOOD-POC-537.
Ravi (Infra): Sample curl (replace <KEY>):
```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rw-gpt-7b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"get recs"}],"stream":true}'
```
Hannah (Sales): Sent to Lyra. They asked: if they keep 70 rps steady for a month, rough monthly cost?
Liam (Platform): Ballpark ~ $1.9k/mo for sustained 70 rps on rw-gpt-7b (current token assumptions). I'll follow up with a formal pricing note.
Lyra (customer via email): Smoke test reached ~430 rps streaming, no errors.
Hannah (Sales): Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Priya (Security): Confirmed minimal logs retained for 7 days. Key will auto-expire per TTL.
Ana (SRE): Monitoring enabled; I'll be on watch during the demo window.
